description: Transcribes speech from any audio or video file ffmpeg can read with OpenAI Whisper, on this machine: plain text, SRT or WebVTT subtitles, or text with timestamps. About 100 languages, detected automatically; can also translate the speech into English. Models: tiny (41 MB), base (77 MB), small (249 MB); bigger is slower and more accurate. Needs ffmpeg. The first call installs Transformers.js with ONNX Runtime (about 450 MB) and downloads the model into the cache.

output.description: Default: <name>.<format> next to the input (.txt for timestamped)

name: speech_to_text
title: Transcribe speech
